## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. HYG/LQD ratio ↓ (credit stress rising) at 0.7374 while tech/semiconductors are strong—XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND—supporting a cycle-positive rotation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD ↓ (HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY; LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY). Stocks vs Bonds NEUTRAL/CORRECTION: SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength ABOVE TREND: UUP proxy (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND → flat; Yield-curve nudging steeper (Yield Curve Level 1.0312 1W: +1.32% | 1M: -1.73% ↑ rising) with TLT in RECOVERY (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND; Semis strong: SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. Materials lag: XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND — Style: Growth/momentum showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND while Emerging Markets EEM (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND shows catch-up; China weak: FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Small caps/IWM recovery: IWM (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND; Disruption/alpha-seeking mixed with ARKK (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY and crypto cooling: IBIT (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/reflation tone: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; Gold under pressure: GLD (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND while Brent BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION and natural gas UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION show short-term pullbacks.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech and semiconductors both timeframes positive (XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY and commodity corrections (BNO, UNG) create cross-market friction—no MAJOR divergence across core equity ETFs.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposures showing leadership (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) and monitor credit signal (HYG/LQD ↓) closely; reduce exposure to weak materials (XLB) and China exposure (FXI) while keeping bonds as neutral/monitor (TLT RECOVERY).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND; FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND; watch BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION for oil volatility.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~26 (VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND) as complacency threshold; HYG/LQD 0.7374 (credit stress ↓) as credit health signal; XLK/XLF 3.4730 (Tech vs Financials) as leadership pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Tech and semiconductors showing strength (XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND) and growth/momentum favored. Key risk: HYG/LQD ↓ (credit stress rising) and TLT in RECOVERY—monitor credit and bond dynamics for a regime shift.
